about.title: Head Softball Coach
about.bio: With years of experience developing players from recreational leagues through varsity and travel ball, I focus on the fundamentals that build confident, consistent athletes. Every player I work with leaves with sharper mechanics and a clearer game plan.

hero.headline: Rise Up. Own the Diamond.
hero.subline: Private softball coaching — pitching mechanics, hitting development, and recruiting prep for players who compete to win.

services.title: Pitching Mechanics
services.description: Individual sessions targeting windmill delivery, spin rates, command, and velocity development for pitchers at every level.

services.title: Hitting & Slapping
services.description: Mechanics, pitch recognition, and plate discipline — build a repeatable swing or slap approach that holds up under pressure.

services.title: Fielding & Catching
services.description: Footwork, glove work, blocking, and throwing mechanics for position players and catchers. Recruiting guidance for high school players.

success_stories.name: Madison R.
success_stories.story: Madison had raw arm speed but mechanics that were creating command issues. We rebuilt her delivery over one off-season, adding movement and dramatically improving her walk rate.
success_stories.result: Varsity Starter · Drop 20% BB Rate · Signed D2

faq.question: What age groups do you train?
faq.answer: We work with players from 8 years old through college level. Sessions are tailored to current skill level and goals.

faq.question: Where do sessions take place?
faq.answer: Training is conducted at local fields and cage facilities in the area. Location is confirmed at booking.

faq.question: How long are sessions?
faq.answer: Standard sessions are 60 minutes. Extended sessions (90 min) are available for players who want more volume.

faq.question: What should my player bring?
faq.answer: Glove, cleats, helmet and bat (if a hitter), and water. Softballs and training equipment are provided.

faq.question: Do you help with recruiting exposure?
faq.answer: Yes — for high school players targeting college ball, I provide guidance on recruiting profiles, video, and outreach strategy.
